words.ex_cn: 这名囚犯和另外两个人共用一间牢房。
words.en: A person who is confined in a prison, hospital, or other institution.

words.ex: The affluent family bought a big house by the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这个富裕的家庭在湖边买了一栋大房子。
words.en: Having a great deal of money; wealthy.

words.ex: The medicine is potent and works quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物非常有效，起效很快。
words.en: Something that is potent is very effective and powerful.

words.ex: We use a repellent to keep mosquitoes away.
words.ex_cn: 我们使用驱虫剂来驱赶蚊子。
words.en: A repellent is a substance that is used to keep insects or animals away from something. It can also refer to something that is extremely unpleasant or disgusting.

words.ex: Some chemicals are known to be carcinogenic.
words.ex_cn: 一些化学物质被认为是致癌的。
words.en: A carcinogenic substance or agent is one that can cause cancer.

words.ex: He picked up a brochure about the city.
words.ex_cn: 他拿了一本关于这座城市的宣传小册子。
words.en: A brochure is a type of small magazine or booklet containing pictures and information about something or advertising something.

words.ex: He had a coronary artery blockage.
words.ex_cn: 他有一条冠状动脉堵塞。
words.en: Relating to the arteries that supply the heart with blood.

words.tr: adj. 未经要求的；自发的；自我推荐的
words.ex: She received an unsolicited gift from a stranger.
words.ex_cn: 她收到了一个陌生人主动送的礼物。
words.en: Not asked for or requested.

words.tr: n. 发炎；炎症；燃烧；激动
words.ex: The redness and swelling show inflammation.
words.ex_cn: 发红和肿胀表明有炎症。
words.en: Inflammation is a condition in which a part of your body becomes red, swollen, and painful as a reaction to infection or injury.

words.ex: The man was incarcerated for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 这个人因偷窃而被监禁。
words.en: If people are incarcerated, they are kept in a prison or other place.

words.ex: She adds yeast to make bread rise.
words.ex_cn: 她加入酵母使面包发酵膨胀。
words.en: Yeast is a type of fungus which is used to make bread rise and to make beer and wine.

words.tr:
v. 加酵母；使发酵；影响
n. 酵素；酵母；潜移默化的影响
words.ex: She uses yeast to leaven the bread.
words.ex_cn: 她用酵母使面包发酵。
words.en: Leaven is a substance, typically yeast, that is used in dough to make it rise. It can also refer to something that modifies or lightens a situation or atmosphere.

words.ex: The team canvass voters for their opinions.
words.ex_cn: 团队征询选民的意见。
words.en: To canvass means to ask people for their votes or opinions, especially in a political context, or to examine something carefully.

words.ex: He poured syrup on his pancakes.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖浆倒在煎饼上。
words.en: A thick, sweet liquid made by dissolving sugar in boiling water, often used as a topping for desserts or as a sweetener in drinks.

words.ex: The doctor found a cystic growth on her ovary.
words.ex_cn: 医生在她的卵巢上发现了一个囊性的肿块。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by cysts or a cyst.

words.tr: n. 整形外科医师（等于 orthopaedist）
words.ex: The orthopedist fixed his broken leg.
words.ex_cn: 这位整形外科医师治好了他断裂的腿。
words.en: An orthopedist is a doctor who specializes in the branch of medicine concerned with the correction or prevention of deformities, disorders, or injuries of the skeleton and associated structures.

words.ex: The old wall began to crumble after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 旧墙在雨后开始坍塌。
words.en: If something crumbles, or if you crumble it, it breaks into a lot of small pieces.

words.ex: The bread became moldy in the warm kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 面包在温暖的厨房里发霉了。
words.en: Something that is moldy is covered with mold.

words.ex: The attrition between the two rocks caused sparks.
words.ex_cn: 两块岩石之间的摩擦产生了火花。
words.en: Attrition refers to the process of reducing something's strength or effectiveness through sustained attack or pressure, or the gradual reduction in the number of employees in an organization by retirement, resignation, or death.

words.ex: The students handed in a petition to the principal.
words.ex_cn: 学生们向校长递交了一份请愿书。
words.en: A petition is a document signed by a lot of people which asks a government or other official group to do a particular thing.

words.ex: He shuns loud parties because he is shy.
words.ex_cn: 他因为害羞而避开热闹的派对。
words.en: If you shun someone or something, you deliberately avoid them or keep away from them.

words.ex: Alzheimer's is a degenerative disease.
words.ex_cn: 阿尔茨海默病是一种衰退性疾病。
words.en: A degenerative disease or condition is one that gradually gets worse.

words.tr: adj. 想复仇的；报复性的；怀恨的
words.ex: He was vindictive and refused to forgive her.
words.ex_cn: 他心怀报复，拒绝原谅她。
words.en: If you say that someone is vindictive, you are critical of them because they deliberately try to upset or cause trouble for someone who they think has done them harm.

words.ex: He has a bronchial infection.
words.ex_cn: 他患有支气管感染。
words.en: Relating to the bronchi or bronchial tubes.

words.ex: He was released on parole after serving half his sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他在服刑一半后获得假释。
words.en: Parole is the release of a prisoner temporarily (for a special purpose) or permanently before the completion of a sentence, on the promise of good behavior.

words.tr: n. 皮肤病学家；皮肤科医生
words.ex: He visited a dermatologist for his skin rash.
words.ex_cn: 他因为皮肤疹去看皮肤科医生。
words.en: A dermatologist is a doctor who specializes in the study, diagnosis, and treatment of skin disorders and diseases.

words.tr: adj. 很长的；漫长的；冗长的；
words.ex: The meeting was lengthy and tiring.
words.ex_cn: 会议很长，很累人。
words.en: Something that is lengthy lasts for a long time, often longer than you want or expect.

words.tr:
n. 大量贮备；囤积
v. 大量储备；囤积
words.ex: The government built a stockpile of food for emergencies.
words.ex_cn: 政府为紧急情况储备了大量食物。
words.en: A stockpile is a large supply of something that is kept to be used in the future.

words.ex: The motif of love appears in many poems.
words.ex_cn: 爱的主题出现在许多诗歌中。
words.en: A motif is a design or pattern that is used in a piece of art or music, or a theme that is repeated in a work of literature.

words.tr:
n. 麻醉剂；鸦片制剂
adj. 含鸦片的；催眠性的
v. 加鸦片麻醉；使（感觉）迟钝；使缓和
words.ex: He took an opiate for his pain.
words.ex_cn: 他服了一种鸦片类药物来缓解疼痛。
words.en: An opiate is a drug that contains opium or a derivative of opium, used to relieve pain or induce sleep.

words.ex: The school will curtail recess time during exams.
words.ex_cn: 学校在考试期间将缩短课间休息时间。
words.en: If you curtail something, you reduce or limit it.

words.ex: The government gave amnesty to political prisoners.
words.ex_cn: 政府向政治犯提供了赦免。
words.en: An amnesty is an official pardon granted to a group of people by a government, especially for political offenses.

words.ex: She is weaning her baby off milk.
words.ex_cn: 她正在让宝宝戒掉牛奶。
words.en: To wean someone off something means to make them gradually stop using or depending on it, especially something harmful or unnecessary.

words.ex: The barge carried coal down the river.
words.ex_cn: 驳船沿河运送煤炭。
words.en: A barge is a long, flat-bottomed boat used for carrying freight on canals and rivers.

words.ex: The broken bridge is a menace to drivers.
words.ex_cn: 这座破桥对司机来说是个危险物。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is a menace, you mean that they are likely to cause serious harm.

words.tr: adj. 过度的；过高的；过分的；
words.ex: The restaurant charged an exorbitant price for a small salad.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅对一份小沙拉要了过高的价格。
words.en: If you describe something such as a price or fee as exorbitant, you are emphasizing that it is much higher than it should be.

words.ex: He visited the doctor for a prostate check.
words.ex_cn: 他去看医生做前列腺检查。
words.en: The prostate is a gland in the male reproductive system that is located just below the bladder and in front of the rectum. It surrounds the urethra, the tube through which urine and semen exit the body.

words.tr: n. 象征物；标志；代金券；代币；
words.ex: The dove is a token of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征物。
words.en: A token is something that represents or stands for something else, especially a piece of metal or plastic that you can use instead of money in some machines or as a symbol of a particular feeling or event.

words.tr: v. 熏蒸；（为灭虫或消毒而）熏烟
words.ex: They fumigate the house to kill bugs.
words.ex_cn: 他们对房子进行熏蒸以杀死害虫。
words.en: To disinfect or purify an area by exposing it to the fumes of certain chemicals.

chapters.name: GMAT 数学专业术语 Algebra & arithmetic terms:

words.ex: The absolute value of -5 is 5.
words.ex_cn: -5 的绝对值是 5。
words.en: The magnitude of a real number without regard to its sign.

words.ex: He adds two and three to get five.
words.ex_cn: 他把二和三相加得到五。
words.en: To put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, or amount.

words.ex: The addition of a new chair made the room more comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 增加一把新椅子让房间更舒适了。
words.en: An addition is something that is added to something else, often to improve it or make it larger.

words.tr: phrase. 平均值；通常指一组数值的算术平均数
words.ex: The average value of 4, 6, and 8 is 6.
words.ex_cn: 4、6和8的平均值是6。
words.en: The mean value of a set of numbers, calculated by dividing the sum of the values by the number of values.

words.ex: He solves algebra problems every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解代数题。
words.en: Algebra is a branch of mathematics in which letters and symbols are used to represent numbers and quantities in formulae and equations.

words.ex: An algebraic expression can include variables, constants, and operations.
words.ex_cn: 代数表达式可以包括变量、常数和运算。
words.en: An algebraic expression is a mathematical phrase that can contain ordinary numbers, variables (like x or y) and operators (like add, subtract, multiply, and divide).

words.tr: phrase. 算术中项；算术平均
words.ex: The arithmetic mean of 4, 6, and 8 is 6.
words.ex_cn: 4、6和8的算术中项是6。
words.en: The arithmetic mean is the sum of a collection of numbers divided by the count of numbers in the collection.

words.tr: phrase. 等差数列：一种数列，其中任意一项与其前一项之间的差是恒定的。
words.ex: The sequence 2, 4, 6, 8 is an arithmetic progression.
words.ex_cn: 序列 2、4、6、8 是一个等差数列。
words.en: A sequence of numbers in which each term after the first is obtained by adding a constant difference to the preceding term.

words.tr: phrase. 等差数列；算术序列（指相邻两项之差为常数的数列）
words.ex: The sequence 2, 4, 6, 8 is an arithmetic sequence with a common difference of 2.
words.ex_cn: 序列2, 4, 6, 8是一个公差为2的算术数列。
words.en: In mathematics, an arithmetic sequence is a sequence of numbers such that the difference between the consecutive terms is constant.

words.tr:
adj. 近似的；大约的；
v. 接近；
words.ex: The approximate cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 费用大约是50美元。
words.en: An approximate number, time, or position is close to the correct number, time, or position, but is not exact.

words.ex: The point has an abscissa of 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个点的横坐标是5。
words.en: The abscissa is the horizontal coordinate in a system of Cartesian coordinates.

words.ex: The point has an ordinate of 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个点的纵坐标是5。
words.en: In mathematics, an ordinate is the y-coordinate of a point in a two-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system.

words.tr:
n. 二项式
adj. 二项式的
words.ex: The binomial theorem is used in algebra.
words.ex_cn: 二项式定理在代数中使用。
words.en: A binomial is a mathematical expression consisting of two terms connected by a plus or minus sign.

words.tr: phrase. 公因数；共同因子（指能同时整除几个数的因数）
words.ex: The common factor of 6 and 9 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 6和9的公因数是3。
words.en: A common factor is a number that divides exactly into two or more other numbers, or a feature that is shared by all members of a group.

words.ex: The common multiple of 4 and 6 is 12.
words.ex_cn: 4和6的公倍数是12。
words.en: A common multiple is a number that is a multiple of two or more numbers.

words.ex: The common divisor of 12 and 18 is 6.
words.ex_cn: 12 和 18 的公因数是 6。
words.en: A common divisor of two or more integers is an integer that divides each of them without leaving a remainder.

words.ex: He solved a simple fraction problem on the board.
words.ex_cn: 他在黑板上解了一个简单的分数问题。
words.en: A simple fraction is a fraction where both the numerator and the denominator are integers, and the denominator is not zero.

words.tr: phrase. 普通分数；常见分数（指由分子和分母组成的分数，如1/2、3/4等）
words.ex: He wrote the answer as a common fraction.
words.ex_cn: 他把答案写成了一个普通分数。
words.en: A common fraction is a fraction in which both the numerator and the denominator are integers.

words.tr: phrase. 复分数（分子或分母中含有分数的分数）
words.ex: He simplified a complex fraction in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上简化了一个繁分数。
words.en: A complex fraction is a fraction where the numerator, the denominator, or both are also fractions.

words.tr: phrase. 常用对数（以10为底的对数）
words.ex: He uses common logarithm to solve the equation.
words.ex_cn: 他用常用对数来解这个方程。
words.en: A logarithm to the base 10, used especially in calculations.

words.ex: The common ratio is 3 in this sequence.
words.ex_cn: 这个数列的公比是3。
words.en: In mathematics, a common ratio is the constant factor between consecutive terms of a geometric sequence.

words.ex: In mathematics, a complex number is used to solve equations that cannot be solved with real numbers alone.
words.ex_cn: 在数学中，复数用于解决仅用实数无法解决的方程。
words.en: In mathematics, a complex number is a number that can be expressed in the form a + bi, where a and b are real numbers, and i is a symbol called the imaginary unit, satisfying the equation i² = −1.

words.tr: phrase. 复共轭（数学中指实部相同而虚部符号相反的复数对）
words.ex: The complex conjugate of 3 + 4i is 3 - 4i.
words.ex_cn: 3 + 4i 的复共轭是 3 - 4i。
words.en: In mathematics, the complex conjugate of a complex number is the number with an equal real part and an imaginary part equal in magnitude but opposite in sign.

words.tr: phrase. 复合数：一个（非零）自然数，可以表示为两个（或更多）自然数的乘积，这些自然数不包括它本身和1。
words.ex: Four is a composite number because it has more than two factors.
words.ex_cn: 四是合数，因为它有超过两个因数。
words.en: A composite number is a positive integer that has at least one positive divisor other than one or itself.

words.ex: Seven is a prime number.
words.ex_cn: 七是一个质数。
words.en: A prime number is a whole number greater than 1 that cannot be exactly divided by any whole number other than itself and 1.

words.tr: phrase. 连续的数字；指一个接一个连续排列的数字，中间没有间隔
words.ex: The sequence of consecutive numbers starts from 1.
words.ex_cn: 连续数的序列从1开始。
words.en: A consecutive number is a number that follows another in order without any gaps.

words.ex: The numbers 2, 4, and 6 are consecutive even integers.
words.ex_cn: 数字 2、4 和 6 是连续的偶数。
words.en: An even integer that follows another even integer without any odd integers in between.

words.ex: The numbers 3, 5, and 7 are consecutive odd integers.
words.ex_cn: 数字3、5和7是连续的奇数。
words.en: A consecutive odd integer refers to an odd number that follows another odd number without any even numbers in between.

words.tr: phrase. 交叉相乘（用于解比例方程时将等式两边的分子与分母分别相乘）
words.ex: To solve the equation, we cross multiply to eliminate the fractions.
words.ex_cn: 为了解这个方程，我们交叉相乘以消除分数。
words.en: To cross multiply is to multiply the numerator of one fraction by the denominator of another fraction and vice versa, typically to solve an equation involving fractions.

words.ex: The coefficient of x is 5 in this equation.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方程中，x 的系数是 5。
words.en: A coefficient is a number that measures a particular characteristic of a substance or a system under specified conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 二次方程；二次方程式
words.ex: The quadratic equation is a fundamental concept in algebra.
words.ex_cn: 二次方程是代数中的一个基本概念。
words.en: A quadratic equation is an equation of the second degree, meaning it contains at least one term that is squared. The standard form is ax² + bx + c = 0, where a, b, and c are coefficients, and a ≠ 0.

words.tr: phrase. 互补函数（在数学中，尤指微分方程的齐次解）
words.ex: The complementary function is used to find the general solution of the differential equation.
words.ex_cn: 补充函数用于求解微分方程的一般解。
words.en: In mathematics, the complementary function is part of the solution to a linear differential equation, representing the solution to the homogeneous equation.

words.tr: adj. 恒定的；不变的；持续的；
words.ex: The temperature is constant in this room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的温度是恒定的。
words.en: Something that is constant happens all the time or is always there.

words.ex: The Cartesian coordinate system is widely used in mathematics.
words.ex_cn: 笛卡尔坐标系统在数学中被广泛使用。
words.en: A coordinate system is a system that uses one or more numbers, or coordinates, to uniquely determine the position of a point or other geometric element on a manifold such as Euclidean space.

words.tr:
adj. 小数的；十进位的
n. 小数
words.ex: The decimal point separates the whole number from the decimal part.
words.ex_cn: 小数点将整数部分与小数部分分开。
words.en: A decimal is a fraction that is written in a special form. It is based on powers of ten, and it uses a decimal point to separate the whole number part from the fractional part.

words.ex: The decimal point separates the whole number from the fraction.
words.ex_cn: 小数点将整数部分与小数部分分开。
words.en: A decimal point is a dot used to separate the whole number part from the fractional part of a number in decimal notation.

words.ex: He wrote 0.5 as a decimal fraction.
words.ex_cn: 他把0.5写成小数分数。
words.en: A decimal fraction is a fraction whose denominator is a power of ten, expressed by placing the numerator to the right of a decimal point.

words.tr: phrase. 十进制算术；基于十进制的计算方法
words.ex: Decimal arithmetic is used extensively in financial calculations.
words.ex_cn: 十进制运算在财务计算中被广泛使用。
words.en: Decimal arithmetic refers to the branch of arithmetic that deals with the decimal number system, which is based on the number ten.

words.tr: phrase. 十进制系统；以十为基础的计数系统
words.ex: We use the decimal system to count numbers.
words.ex_cn: 我们用十进制系统来计数。
words.en: The decimal system is a base-10 number system, which is the standard system for denoting integer and non-integer numbers.

words.tr: phrase. 十进制刻度；基于十进制的计量尺度
words.ex: The decimal scale is widely used in mathematics.
words.ex_cn: 十进位制在数学中被广泛使用。
words.en: A decimal scale is a system of measurement or numbering that is based on the number ten.

words.ex: The denominator is 5 in the fraction 3/5.
words.ex_cn: 在分数 3/5 中，分母是 5。
words.en: The number below the line in a fraction that shows the number of equal parts into which the whole is divided.

words.ex: There is a big difference between apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果和橙子之间有很大的差异。
words.en: A difference is a way in which two or more things are not the same.

words.tr: phrase. 正比关系；直接比例（指两个量之间比值保持不变的关系）
words.ex: The more apples you buy, the more money you pay; it is a direct proportion.
words.ex_cn: 你买的苹果越多，付的钱就越多；这是一种正比例。
words.en: A relationship between two quantities in which the ratio of one quantity to the other is constant.

words.ex: She will divide the cake into two parts.
words.ex_cn: 她将把蛋糕分成两部分。
words.en: If you divide something, you separate it into two or more parts.

words.tr: phrase. 均分：将某物分成相等的部分或数量。
words.ex: The cake was divided evenly among the children.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕被平均分给了孩子们。
words.en: If something is divided evenly, it is split into equal parts or amounts.

words.tr:
adj. 差别的；有区别的
n. 差别；差额；差价
words.ex: There is a differential cost between the two brands.
words.ex_cn: 这两个品牌之间有不同的价格。
words.en: A differential is a difference between things, especially between things that should be the same. In mathematics, a differential is an infinitesimal change in a variable.

words.ex: The two colors are distinct.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色有区别。
words.en: If something is distinct, it is easily seen, heard, or understood.

words.tr: n. 被除数；股份红利；股息
words.ex: In 12 ÷ 3 = 4, the dividend is 12.
words.en: A dividend is a sum of money paid regularly (typically annually) by a company to its shareholders out of its profits (or reserves).

words.ex: The division of the cake was fair.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的划分是公平的。
words.en: The act or process of dividing something into parts or the state of being divided.

words.tr: phrase. 除号；表示除法运算的符号（如 ÷）
words.ex: The division sign looks like this: ÷.
words.ex_cn: 除号看起来像这样：÷。
words.en: The division sign is a mathematical symbol consisting of a short horizontal line with a dot above and below it, used to indicate the operation of division.

words.ex: The divisor is 5 in this math problem.
words.ex_cn: 在这个数学题中，除数是5。
words.en: A divisor is a number by which another number is to be divided.

words.tr: adj. 可被整除的；可分的
words.ex: The number 12 is divisible by 3.
words.ex_cn: 12 能被 3 整除。
words.en: Capable of being divided, especially with no remainder.

words.tr: phrase. 等值分数；表示相同数值的不同分数形式
words.ex: Two halves and four quarters are equivalent fractions.
words.ex_cn: 两个二分之一和四个四分之一是相等的分数。
words.en: Fractions that represent the same part of a whole, even though they may look different.

words.tr: phrase. 等价方程；表示相同数学关系的不同方程形式
words.ex: Solving the original equation is equivalent to solving its equivalent equation.
words.ex_cn: 解原方程等价于解其等价方程。
words.en: An equivalent equation is one that has the same solution set as another equation.

words.tr: phrase. 等价关系：在数学中，指满足自反性、对称性和传递性的二元关系
words.ex: The equals sign is an equivalence relation.
words.ex_cn: 等号是一个等价关系。
words.en: In mathematics, an equivalence relation is a binary relation that is reflexive, symmetric, and transitive.

words.ex: Two is an even integer.
words.ex_cn: n. 2是一个偶数。
words.en: An even integer is a whole number that is divisible by two without a remainder.

words.ex: Four is an even number.
words.ex_cn: 四是偶数。
words.en: An even number is an integer that is divisible by two.

words.tr: n. 阐述者；拥护者；代表者；指数
words.ex: He is the exponent of modern education reform.
words.ex_cn: 他是现代教育改革的阐述者。
words.en: An exponent is someone who supports and explains a particular idea, theory, or system, or a symbol that shows how many times a number is to be multiplied by itself.

words.ex: The equation is easy to solve.
words.ex_cn: 这个方程式很容易解。
words.en: An equation is a mathematical statement that asserts the equality of two expressions.

words.tr: phrase. 一次方程；线性方程（指未知数的最高次数为1的方程）
words.ex: Solving the equation of the first degree involves isolating the variable on one side of the equation.
words.ex_cn: 解一次方程需要将变量隔离在方程的一侧。
words.en: An equation of the first degree is a mathematical statement that shows the equality of two expressions, where the highest power of the variable is one.

words.ex: The bus stops at the endpoint.
words.ex_cn: 公交车在终点站停下。
words.en: An endpoint is a point at which something ends or is complete.

words.ex: His estimation of the situation was wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他对形势的判断是错误的。
words.en: An estimation is a judgment or opinion about the value, quality, or importance of something, or a calculation of the amount, level, or size of something.

words.tr:
n. 因素；要素；倍数；
v. 把…因素包括进去；
words.ex: Weather is a factor in the game's outcome.
words.ex_cn: 天气是比赛结果的一个因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, decision, or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 可因式分解的二次方程
words.ex: The teacher explained how to solve a factorable quadratic equation by factoring it into two binomials.
words.ex_cn: 老师解释了如何通过将二次方程因式分解为两个二项式来求解可因式分解的二次方程。
words.en: A quadratic equation that can be expressed as a product of two binomials.

words.tr: phrase. 不完全二次方程（缺少一次项或常数项的二次方程）
words.ex: The incomplete quadratic equation lacks the linear term.
words.ex_cn: 这个不完全二次方程缺少一次项。
words.en: An incomplete quadratic equation is a quadratic equation that lacks one or more of its terms, specifically the linear term (bx), making it simpler to solve than a complete quadratic equation.

words.tr: adj. 因子的，阶乘的; n. [数] 阶乘
words.ex: The factorial of 5 is 120.
words.ex_cn: 5的阶乘是120。
words.en: In mathematics, the factorial of a non-negative integer n, denoted by n!, is the product of all positive integers less than or equal to n.

words.tr: n. [数] 因子分解；[数] 因式分解
words.ex: He learned factorization in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上学了因式分解。
words.en: The process of breaking down a number or a polynomial into a product of other numbers or polynomials, which when multiplied together give the original.

words.tr: phrase. 几何平均数；等比中项
words.ex: The geometric mean of 4 and 9 is 6.
words.ex_cn: 4 和 9 的几何平均数是 6。
words.en: The geometric mean is a type of average that indicates the central tendency or typical value of a set of numbers by using the product of their values (as opposed to the arithmetic mean which uses their sum).

words.tr: phrase. 图论（数学的一个分支，研究图的性质及其应用）
words.ex: Graph theory is widely used in computer science and network analysis.
words.ex_cn: 图论在计算机科学和网络分析中得到了广泛应用。
words.en: Graph theory is a branch of mathematics that studies graphs, which are mathematical structures used to model pairwise relations between objects.

words.ex: The inequality between rich and poor is growing.
words.ex_cn: 贫富之间的不平等正在加剧。
words.en: Inequality refers to the unfair situation in society when some people have more opportunities, money, etc. than other people.

words.ex: The fraction 7/3 is an improper fraction.
words.ex_cn: 分数 7/3 是一个假分式。
words.en: An improper fraction is a fraction in which the numerator is greater than or equal to the denominator.

words.ex: One third is an infinite decimal.
words.ex_cn: 三分之一是一个无限小数。
words.en: An infinite decimal is a decimal number that continues infinitely, without ending.

words.ex: The time decreases as the speed increases in inverse proportion.
words.ex_cn: 时间随着速度的增加而减少，呈反比关系。
words.en: A relationship between two quantities such that one increases in proportion as the other decreases.

words.ex: Pi is an irrational number.
words.ex_cn: π是一个无理数。
words.en: An irrational number is a real number that cannot be expressed as a ratio of integers, i.e., as a simple fraction.

words.ex: Infinitesimal calculus is a fundamental tool in many fields of science and engineering.
words.ex_cn: 无穷小微积分是许多科学和工程领域的基础工具。
words.en: Infinitesimal calculus is a branch of mathematics that deals with the finding and properties of derivatives and integrals of functions, by methods originally based on the summation of infinitesimal differences. The two main types are differential calculus and integral calculus.

words.ex: The stars seem to go on to infinity.
words.ex_cn: 星星似乎延伸到无限。
words.en: Infinity is a concept of something that is unlimited, endless, without bound.

words.ex: The difference between the two values is infinitesimal.
words.ex_cn: 这两个值之间的差异极微。
words.en: Something that is infinitesimal is extremely small.

words.ex: The function is both integrable and continuous.
words.ex_cn: 这个函数既可积又连续。
words.en: Capable of being integrated or made whole.

words.ex: Honesty is an integral part of a good relationship.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是良好关系中不可或缺的一部分。
words.en: Something that is integral is very important or necessary. If something is an integral part of a whole, it is an essential part of that whole.

words.tr: phrase. 【数】整环（无零因子的交换环）
words.ex: In abstract algebra, an integral domain is a commutative ring with no zero divisors.
words.ex_cn: 在抽象代数中，整环是一个没有零因子的交换环。
words.en: An integral domain is a type of mathematical structure in abstract algebra that is a commutative ring with a multiplicative identity and no zero divisors.

words.ex: The integrand in the integral equation must be continuous.
words.ex_cn: 积分方程中的被积函数必须是连续的。
words.en: In calculus, the integrand is the function to be integrated.

words.tr: phrase. 积分因子；积分乘子（用于将一阶线性微分方程转化为恰当微分方程的乘式函数）
words.ex: The integrating factor method is used to solve first-order linear differential equations.
words.ex_cn: 积分因子法用于求解一阶线性微分方程。
words.en: An integrating factor is a function that is used to simplify the process of solving certain types of differential equations.

words.tr: phrase. 反函数；逆函数（将原函数的输入与输出互换的函数）
words.ex: The inverse function of f(x) = y is f⁻¹(y) = x.
words.ex_cn: 函数 f(x) = y 的反函数是 f⁻¹(y) = x。
words.en: An inverse function is a function that reverses the effect of the original function. If the original function turns an input x into an output y, the inverse function turns y back into x.

words.ex: The inverse order of the numbers is 5, 4, 3, 2, 1.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的倒序是5、4、3、2、1。
words.en: If there is an inverse relationship between two things, one of them becomes larger as the other becomes smaller.

words.ex: They have a reciprocal agreement to help each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们有一个互相帮助的互惠协议。
words.en: A reciprocal action or agreement involves two people or groups who do the same thing to each other or agree to help each other in a similar way.

words.tr: phrase. 最小公分母；最低共同标准；最小公共衡量尺度
words.ex: We found the least common denominator to add the fractions.
words.ex_cn: 我们找到了最小公分母来相加这些分数。
words.en: The smallest number that is a multiple of all the denominators of a given set of fractions.

words.ex: The least common multiple of 4 and 6 is 12.
words.ex_cn: 4和6的最小公倍数是12。
words.en: The smallest positive integer that is a multiple of two or more integers.

words.ex: In the term 3x, the literal coefficient is x.
words.ex_cn: 在项3x中，字母系数是x。
words.en: In algebra, a literal coefficient is a coefficient that is represented by a letter rather than a number.

words.tr: phrase. 同类项（在代数式中，所含字母相同且各字母的指数也分别相同的项）
words.ex: In the expression 3x + 2x, 3x and 2x are like terms and can be combined to 5x.
words.ex_cn: 在表达式3x + 2x中，3x和2x是同类项，可以合并为5x。
words.en: In algebra, like terms are terms that contain the same variables raised to the same power. Only the coefficients may differ.

words.ex: The graph shows a linear relationship between time and distance.
words.ex_cn: 这张图显示了时间与距离之间的线性关系。
words.en: Linear means involving or relating to a straight line or lines.

words.ex: In the equation 7 - 3 = 4, the minuend is 7.
words.ex_cn: 在等式7 - 3 = 4中，被减数是7。
words.en: In arithmetic, the minuend is the number from which another number (the subtrahend) is to be subtracted.

words.ex: In the equation 5 - 3 = 2, the subtrahend is 3.
words.ex_cn: 在等式5 - 3 = 2中，减数是3。
words.en: In arithmetic, the subtrahend is the number that is to be subtracted from another number (the minuend) to produce the difference.

words.tr:
adj. 次要的；轻微的；小的；小调的；
n. 未成年人；
words.ex: The mistake was a minor error.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是一个小错误。
words.en: A minor is a person who is under the age at which they legally become an adult.

words.ex: In the multiplication 3 x 4 = 12, the number 4 is the multiplicand.
words.ex_cn: 在乘法 3 x 4 = 12 中，数字 4 是被乘数。
words.en: A number that is to be multiplied by another number (the multiplier).

words.ex: He learned multiplication in second grade.
words.ex_cn: 他在二年级学习了乘法。
words.en: Multiplication is the process of calculating the total of one number multiplied by another.

words.ex: The multiplier effect of the new policy was significant.
words.ex_cn: 新政策的乘数效应非常显著。
words.en: A multiplier is a number by which another number is multiplied. In economics, it refers to the factor by which the return from an expenditure exceeds the expenditure itself.

words.tr:
n. 单项式
adj. 单项的
words.ex: The polynomial can be decomposed into several monomials.
words.ex_cn: 这个多项式可以分解成几个单项式。
words.en: A monomial is an algebraic expression consisting of a single term.

words.tr:
v. 意思；导致；打算；
n. 平均数；
adj. 低劣；平均；
words.ex: What does this word mean?
words.ex_cn: 这个词是什么意思？
words.en: If you want to know what a word, a sentence, or an expression means, you want to know what it refers to or what its significance is.

words.ex: The mode of transportation is a bike.
words.ex_cn: 出行的方式是骑自行车。
words.en: A mode is a particular way or style in which something is done or experienced.

words.tr:
n. 中位数；（三角形的）中线
adj. 中间值的；中间的
words.ex: The median of 3, 5, and 7 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 3、5和7的中位数是5。
words.en: The median is the middle number in a sorted, ascending or descending, list of numbers and can be more descriptive of that data set than the average.

words.ex: The temperature is a negative number: -5 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 温度是一个负数：-5度。
words.en: A negative number is a real number that is less than zero.

words.ex: Five is a positive number.
words.ex_cn: 五是一个正数。
words.en: A positive number is a real number that is greater than zero.

words.ex: The numerator is 5 in the fraction 5/8.
words.ex_cn: 在分数 5/8 中，分子是 5。
words.en: The numerator is the top number in a fraction that shows how many parts of the whole are being considered.

words.tr: phrase. 空集；零测集；不包含任何元素的集合
words.ex: The null set is a subset of every set.
words.ex_cn: 空集是每个集合的子集。
words.en: In mathematics, a null set is a set that has no elements.

words.tr: phrase. 空集；不含任何元素的集合
words.ex: The empty set has no elements.
words.ex_cn: 空集没有元素。
words.en: In mathematics, the empty set is the unique set having no elements; its size or cardinality (count of elements in a set) is zero. Some axiomatic set theories ensure that the empty set exists by including an axiom of empty set; in other theories, its existence can be deduced.

words.tr: phrase. 数论（数学的一个分支，研究整数的性质及其相互关系）
words.ex: Number theory is a branch of pure mathematics devoted primarily to the study of the integers.
words.ex_cn: 数论是纯数学的一个分支，主要研究整数的性质。
words.en: Number theory is a branch of pure mathematics devoted primarily to the study of the integers and integer-valued functions.

words.tr: phrase. 数值分析；研究用近似算法解决数学问题的学科
words.ex: Numerical analysis is a crucial tool in scientific computing.
words.ex_cn: 数值分析是科学计算中的一个关键工具。
words.en: Numerical analysis is the study of algorithms that use numerical approximation for the problems of mathematical analysis.

words.tr: phrase. 自然对数（以 e 为底的对数）
words.ex: The calculator shows the natural logarithm of 10.
words.ex_cn: 计算器显示10的自然对数。
words.en: The natural logarithm is the logarithm to the base e, where e is an irrational and transcendental constant approximately equal to 2.718281828459.

words.ex: Five is a natural number.
words.ex_cn: 五是一个自然数。
words.en: A natural number is a positive integer used in counting and ordering.

words.ex: The number is nonnegative.
words.ex_cn: 这个数是非负的。
words.en: A nonnegative number or quantity is either positive or zero.

words.ex: The original equation was too complex to solve directly.
words.ex_cn: 原始方程太复杂，无法直接求解。
words.en: An equation in its initial form, before any modifications or simplifications have been made.

words.tr: phrase. 顺序量表；序数量表；表示等级或顺序但无固定数值间隔的测量尺度
words.ex: In statistics, an ordinal scale is used to rank data.
words.ex_cn: 在统计学中，序数尺度用于对数据进行排序。
words.en: An ordinal scale is a scale of measurement that represents the order of items but does not measure the difference between them.

words.tr:
adj. 序数的；顺序的
n. 序数
words.ex: The ordinal number is third.
words.ex_cn: 序数是第三。
words.en: An ordinal number is a number such as first, second, third, etc., that shows the position of something in a list.

words.ex: The percentage of students who passed the test was 85.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生百分比是85。
words.en: A percentage is a proportion or ratio expressed as a fraction of 100.

words.tr: n. 圆括号；插入成分（parenthesis 的复数）
words.ex: The information in parentheses is optional.
words.ex_cn: 括号中的信息是可选的。
words.en: Parentheses are a pair of marks ( ) that are used around a word, phrase, or sentence in writing to separate it from the main part of the text.

words.tr:
adj. [数]多项式的； [生]多词学名的
n. [数]多项式； [生]多词学名
words.ex: The polynomial function can be used to model complex data sets.
words.ex_cn: 多项式函数可以用来模拟复杂的数据集。
words.en: A polynomial is a mathematical expression consisting of variables and coefficients, involving only the operations of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and non-negative integer exponents of variables.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.ex: This company makes a new product every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年都会推出一种新产品。
words.en: A product is something that is produced and sold in large quantities, often as a result of a manufacturing process.

words.tr: phrase. 真分数（分子小于分母的分数）
words.ex: The fraction 3/4 is a proper fraction.
words.ex_cn: 分数 3/4 是一个真分数。
words.en: A fraction where the numerator is less than the denominator, and the value is less than one.

words.ex: The proportion of students who passed the test was high.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生比例很高。
words.en: A proportion is a part of a whole, or the relationship of one part to another in terms of size, amount, or degree.

words.tr: n. 排列；排列中的任一组数字或文字
words.ex: He solved the permutation problem in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上解出了这个排列问题。
words.en: A permutation is a way in which a set of things can be ordered or arranged.

words.tr: phrase. 真子集；在集合论中指一个集合的子集，且不等于原集合本身
words.ex: Set A is a proper subset of set B.
words.ex_cn: 集合A是集合B的真子集。
words.en: A proper subset is a subset that is strictly contained within another set, meaning it does not contain all the elements of the containing set.

words.tr: phrase. 质因数：一个质数作为因数的因数。
words.ex: The prime factor of 7 is 7.
words.ex_cn: 7的质因数是7。
words.en: A prime factor is a factor of a number that is a prime number.

words.ex: There has been slow progression in his math skills.
words.ex_cn: 他的数学技能有了缓慢的进展。
words.en: The process of developing or moving gradually towards a more advanced state.

words.tr: n. 四分之一圆周；象限；四分仪
words.ex: The point lies in the first quadrant of the circle.
words.ex_cn: 这个点位于圆的四分之一圆周的第一象限。
words.en: A quadrant is one of the four equal parts into which a circle is divided by two lines that cross each other at right angles.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.

words.ex: The ratio of boys to girls is 3 to 2.
words.ex_cn: 男孩与女孩的比例是3比2。
words.en: A ratio is a relationship between two numbers indicating how many times the first number contains the second.

words.ex: The answer is a real number.
words.ex_cn: 答案是一个实数。
words.en: A real number is a value that represents a quantity along a continuous line, which includes all rational and irrational numbers.

words.ex: The party rounded off the year with a big concert.
words.ex_cn: 这场派对以一场大型音乐会圆满结束了这一年。
words.en: To complete or finish something in a satisfactory or perfect way.

words.tr: phrase. 把（数字）四舍五入到…；使（船）掉头迎风
words.ex: The captain ordered the crew to round to before anchoring.
words.ex_cn: 船长命令船员在抛锚前转向。
words.en: To adjust a number to the nearest whole number or to a specified number of decimal places.

words.tr:
n. 根；根源；
v. 生根；
words.ex: The root of 9 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 9的平方根是3。
words.en: The root of a plant is the part that grows underground and absorbs water and minerals. It can also refer to the origin or cause of something.

words.ex: The radical sign shows the square root.
words.ex_cn: 根号表示平方根。
words.en: The symbol (√) used to denote the square root or other roots of a number.

words.tr: phrase. 根号（数学符号√，用于表示平方根或其他次方根）
words.ex: The root sign looks like a checkmark with a line.
words.ex_cn: 根号看起来像一个带横线的勾号。
words.en: A symbol (√) placed before a number to indicate that the square root is to be extracted.

words.tr: phrase. 循环小数：一个小数，其中一些数字会无限重复出现。
words.ex: One third is a recurring decimal.
words.ex_cn: 三分之一是一个循环小数。
words.en: A recurring decimal is a decimal number that, after some point, has a digit or a group of digits that repeat infinitely.

words.ex: The sequence of numbers is 1, 2, 3, 4.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的顺序是1、2、3、4。
words.en: A sequence is a set of related events, movements, or items that follow each other in a particular order.

words.ex: The two words are similar terms.
words.ex_cn: 这两个词是相似的术语。
words.en: Expressions that have the same variable and exponent, allowing them to be combined through addition or subtraction.

words.ex: He has tens of apples in his basket.
words.ex_cn: 他的篮子里有几十个苹果。
words.en: The number ten.

words.tr: n. 十分位（tenth 的复数形式）
words.ex: The price is five and three tenths dollars.
words.ex_cn: 价格是五点三美元。
words.en: The ordinal number matching the number ten in a series.

words.tr:
adj. [数]三项式的；[生]三名法的
n. [数]三项式；[生]三名法
words.ex: The trinomial can be factored into two binomials.
words.ex_cn: 这个三项式可以因式分解为两个二项式。
words.en: A trinomial is a polynomial that consists of three terms.

words.ex: Each unit in the course lasts two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 课程中的每个单元持续两周。
words.en: Units refer to individual parts or elements that are part of a larger whole, often used in the context of measurement, education, or components of a system.

words.ex: This box weighs one unit.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子重一单位。
words.en: A unit is a single thing or person that is part of something larger.

words.tr: phrase. 加权平均数；按权重计算的平均值
words.ex: The company uses a weighted average to calculate the cost of goods sold.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用加权平均法来计算销售商品的成本。
words.en: A weighted average is an average resulting from the multiplication of each component by a factor reflecting its importance.

words.ex: The two countries formed a union to strengthen trade.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家组成了一个联盟以加强贸易。
words.en: An organization of workers formed to protect their rights and interests; the act of joining two or more things together.

words.ex: The children play in the yard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在院子里玩耍。
words.en: A yard is an area of land next to a building, often with grass and plants, or a unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 meters.

words.tr: phrase. 整数；自然数（包括零）
words.ex: He counted the apples and got a whole number.
words.ex_cn: 他数了苹果，得到了一个整数。
words.en: A whole number is a number without fractions; an integer.

words.tr: phrase. 相互排斥的；互不相容的；不能同时成立的
words.ex: The two events are mutually exclusive.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件是互斥的。
words.en: If two things are mutually exclusive, they cannot exist or be true at the same time.

words.tr: phrase. 独立事件（概率论中指互不影响的事件）
words.ex: The outcome of flipping a coin and rolling a die are independent events.
words.ex_cn: 抛硬币和掷骰子的结果是独立事件。
words.en: In probability theory, independent events are two events where the occurrence of one does not affect the probability of the other occurring.

words.ex: The probability of rain tomorrow is high.
words.ex_cn: 明天下雨的概率很高。
words.en: A probability is a measure of how likely it is that some event will occur.

words.ex: The lock uses a simple combination of three numbers.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁使用三个数字的简单组合。
words.en: A combination is a mixture of things or people that are combined.

words.tr: phrase. 标准差；标准偏差（统计学中衡量数据离散程度的指标）
words.ex: The standard deviation is a measure of the amount of variation or dispersion in a set of values.
words.ex_cn: 标准差是衡量一组数值中变异或离散程度的一种度量。
words.en: A measure of the amount of variation or dispersion of a set of values.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.tr: phrase. 频率分布；一种统计方法，用于显示数据中各个数值或区间出现的次数或频率
words.ex: The teacher showed the frequency distribution of test scores.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了考试成绩的频数分布。
words.en: A frequency distribution is a representation, either in a graphical or tabular format, that displays the number of observations within a given interval. The intervals must be mutually exclusive and exhaustive.

words.ex: He is an expert in the domain of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 他是人工智能领域的专家。
words.en: A domain is a particular field of thought, activity, or interest, especially one over which someone has control, influence, or rights.

words.ex: The bar graph shows the number of students in each class.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形图显示了每个班级的学生人数。
words.en: A bar graph is a chart that uses bars to show comparisons among categories. The bars can be either horizontal or vertical.

chapters.name: GMAT数学专业术语 Geometry terms:

words.ex: The angle bisector cuts the angle into two equal parts.
words.ex_cn: 角平分线将角分成两个相等的部分。
words.en: An angle bisector is a line or ray that divides an angle into two equal angles.

words.tr: phrase. 邻角：共享一条公共边的一对角。
words.ex: The two adjacent angles form a straight line.
words.ex_cn: 这两个相邻的角组成一条直线。
words.en: An adjacent angle is one of a pair of angles with a common vertex and side but no interior points in common.

words.tr: phrase. （几何）内错角的；交替的角
words.ex: The alternate angle theorem helps find unknown angles.
words.ex_cn: 内错角定理有助于找到未知角。
words.en: An alternate angle is one of a pair of angles that are on opposite sides of a transversal and between the two lines it intersects.

words.ex: The triangle has an acute angle.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有一个锐角。
words.en: An acute angle is an angle that is less than 90 degrees. It is one of the basic types of angles in geometry.

words.ex: The triangle has an obtuse angle.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有一个钝角。
words.en: An angle that is greater than 90 degrees but less than 180 degrees.

words.ex: The line bisects the angle into two equal parts.
words.ex_cn: 这条线将角平分为两个相等的部分。
words.en: To divide something into two equal parts.

words.tr: phrase. 相邻的顶点（在图论或几何中指通过一条边直接相连的两个顶点）
words.ex: In graph theory, adjacent vertices share an edge.
words.ex_cn: 在图论中，相邻顶点共享一条边。
words.en: In graph theory, adjacent vertices are two vertices that are connected by an edge.

words.tr:
v. 成弧线；
n. 弧；弧形物；
words.ex: The rainbow arcs across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹在天空中形成一道弧线。
words.en: An arc is a smoothly curving line or movement.

words.ex: The village is at an altitude of 2,000 meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的海拔是2000米。
words.en: The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

words.tr:
n. 手臂；
v. 武装；
words.ex: He raised his arm to wave hello.
words.ex_cn: 他举起手臂打招呼。
words.en: An arm is one of the two long parts of your body that are attached to your shoulders and that have your hands at the end.

words.tr: phrase. 复平面（用于表示复数的几何平面，其中横轴代表实部，纵轴代表虚部）
words.ex: The complex plane is used to represent complex numbers graphically.
words.ex_cn: 复平面用于以图形方式表示复数。
words.en: A complex plane is a geometric representation of the complex numbers established by the real axis and the imaginary axis.

words.tr: phrase. 凸多边形（每个内角小于180度且所有顶点都向外突出的多边形）
words.ex: A convex polygon has all interior angles less than 180 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 凸多边形的所有内角都小于180度。
words.en: A convex polygon is a simple polygon (not self-intersecting) in which no line segment between two points on the boundary ever goes outside the polygon.

words.tr: phrase. 凹多边形（至少有一个内角大于180度的多边形）
words.ex: A concave polygon has at least one interior angle greater than 180 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 凹多边形至少有一个内角大于180度。
words.en: A polygon that has at least one interior angle greater than 180 degrees, causing it to 'cave in' on itself.

words.ex: In geometry, a complementary angle to 30° is 60°.
words.ex_cn: 在几何学中，30度的补角是60度。
words.en: Either of two angles whose sum is 90°.

words.ex: The child played with a wooden cube.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩了一个木制立方体。
words.en: A cube is a solid object with six square faces which are all the same size.

words.ex: The central angle of a sector is twice the inscribed angle subtended by the same arc.
words.ex_cn: 一个扇形的中心角是同一个弧所对的圆周角的二倍。
words.en: In geometry, a central angle is an angle whose vertex is at the center of a circle and whose sides (rays) extend to the circumference, thereby subtending an arc.

words.tr:
n. 圆；圈；
v. 圈出；环绕；
words.ex: The child drew a circle with a pen.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用笔画了一个圆。
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

words.tr:
adv. 顺时针方向地
adj. 顺时针方向的
words.ex: Turn the knob clockwise to open the jar.
words.ex_cn: 顺时针转动旋钮来打开罐子。
words.en: Moving in the same direction as the hands of a clock.

words.tr:
adj. 逆时针方向的
adv. 逆时针方向地
words.ex: The fan spins counterclockwise.
words.ex_cn: 风扇逆时针旋转。
words.en: In the opposite direction to the way in which the hands of a clock move.

words.ex: The guitarist played a C major chord.
words.ex_cn: 吉他手弹了一个C大和弦。
words.en: A chord is a group of three or more musical notes played together.

words.ex: The container was shaped like a circular cylinder.
words.ex_cn: 这个容器的形状像一个圆柱体。
words.en: A circular cylinder is a three-dimensional geometric figure with straight parallel sides and a circular or oval cross section.

words.tr: adj. 符合的；一致的；全等的
words.ex: The two shapes are congruent in size.
words.ex_cn: 这两个形状大小相符。
words.en: If one thing is congruent with another, they are similar or fit together well.

words.tr: phrase. 对应的角（几何中指两条直线被第三条直线所截时位置相对应的角）
words.ex: The corresponding angles are equal when the lines are parallel.
words.ex_cn: 当直线平行时，对应角相等。
words.en: In geometry, corresponding angles are the angles that are in the same position relative to the transversal and the two lines.

words.ex: The circumference of the circle is 31.4 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个圆的周长是31.4厘米。
words.en: The circumference of a circle is the distance around it.

words.ex: The fence marks the perimeter of the garden.
words.ex_cn: 围栏标出了花园的边界。
words.en: The perimeter of an area or object is the total length of its sides or outer boundary.

words.tr: phrase. 同心的圆；具有相同中心的圆形
words.ex: The pattern of concentric circles was created by the ripples on the water.
words.ex_cn: 水波荡漾形成的同心圆图案。
words.en: Circles that have the same center.

words.ex: The circle graph shows the distribution of different age groups in the population.
words.ex_cn: 这张饼图显示了人口中不同年龄组的分布情况。
words.en: A circle graph, also known as a pie chart, is a circular statistical graphic that is divided into slices to illustrate numerical proportions.

words.tr: n. 球果；松球；圆锥体；圆锥形物；
words.ex: The pine tree dropped a brown cone on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 松树掉下一个棕色的球果在地上。
words.en: A cone is a shape with a circular base that narrows to a point at the top.

words.ex: The law circumscribes what companies can do.
words.ex_cn: 法律限制了公司能做的事情。
words.en: To circumscribe something means to limit its size, activity, or scope, often by setting boundaries or restrictions.

words.ex: He inscribes his name on the stone.
words.ex_cn: 他把名字刻在石头上。
words.en: To write, mark, or engrave (words, symbols, etc.) on a surface, especially as a formal or permanent record.

words.tr:
adj. 对角线的；斜的
n. 对角线；斜线
words.ex: The square has two diagonal lines.
words.ex_cn: 这个正方形有两条对角线。
words.en: A diagonal line or movement goes in a sloping direction, for example, from one corner of a square across to the opposite corner.

words.ex: The child drew a decagon with ten sides.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一个有十条边的十边形。
words.en: A decagon is a polygon with ten sides and ten angles.

words.ex: The bee built a hexagon with wax.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜡建造了一个六边形。
words.en: A hexagon is a six-sided polygon.

words.ex: The architect designed a building with a nonagon-shaped roof.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师设计了一座屋顶为九边形形状的建筑。
words.en: A nine-sided polygon.

words.ex: The stop sign is an octagon.
words.ex_cn: 交通标志是一个八边形。
words.en: An octagon is a polygon with eight sides and eight angles.

words.ex: The pentagon is a five-sided shape.
words.ex_cn: 五边形是一个五边的形状。
words.en: A pentagon is a five-sided polygon.

words.tr:
adj. 四边的；四边形的
n. 四边形
words.ex: The quadrilateral shape has four sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个四边的形状有四条边。
words.en: A quadrilateral is a polygon with four sides and four angles.

words.ex: He drew a pentagon, which is a polygon.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个五边形，它是一个多边形。
words.en: A polygon is a flat shape with three or more straight sides and angles.

words.ex: The diameter of the circle is 10 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个圆的直径是10厘米。
words.en: A straight line passing from side to side through the center of a body or figure, especially a circle or sphere.

words.ex: The edge of the table is sharp.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的边缘很锋利。
words.en: The edge of something is the place or line where it stops, or the part of it that is furthest from the middle.

words.ex: The triangle has three equal sides, so it is an equilateral triangle.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三条相等的边，所以它是一个等边三角形。
words.en: A triangle with all sides and angles equal.

words.ex: The exterior angle is 120 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 外角是120度。
words.en: An exterior angle is an angle formed by one side of a polygon and the extension of an adjacent side.

words.ex: The triangle has three interior angles.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三个内角。
words.en: An interior angle is an angle inside a shape, formed by two sides of the shape.

words.ex: The extent of his knowledge surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的知识广度让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The area or length to which something extends.

words.w: exterior angles on the same side of the transversal
words.tr: phrase. 同旁外角（两条直线被一条横截线所截时，位于横截线同侧且在两条直线外侧的两个角）
words.uk: ɪkˈstɪəriə ˈæŋɡlz ɒn ðə seɪm saɪd əv ðə trænsˈvɜːsəl
words.us: ɪkˈstɪriər ˈæŋɡlz ɑːn ðə seɪm saɪd əv ðə trænsˈvɜsəl
words.ex: In geometry, exterior angles on the same side of the transversal are supplementary.
words.ex_cn: 在几何学中，在同一侧的同旁外角是互补的。
words.en: Exterior angles on the same side of the transversal are angles that are outside the parallel lines and on the same side of the transversal. They are equal when the lines are parallel.

words.tr: phrase. 斜三角形（指不含直角的任意三角形）
words.ex: An oblique triangle is a triangle that does not contain a right angle.
words.ex_cn: 斜三角形是不包含直角的三角形。
words.en: An oblique triangle is a triangle that does not contain a right angle.

words.ex: Plane geometry deals with shapes and figures that lie on a single plane.
words.ex_cn: 平面几何处理位于单一平面上的形状和图形。
words.en: Plane geometry is the branch of mathematics that deals with the properties and relations of points, lines, angles, surfaces, and solids in a two-dimensional space.

words.tr: n. 扁圆形；[天] 扁率
words.ex: The oblateness of the Earth is a result of its rotation.
words.ex_cn: 地球的扁率是其自转的结果。
words.en: The degree of flattening at the poles of a celestial body, caused by its rotation.

words.ex: He drew an ellipse on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个椭圆。
words.en: An ellipse is a regular oval shape, traced by a point moving in a plane so that the sum of its distances from two other points (the foci) is constant.

words.ex: The shape has four sides, and opposite sides are parallel; it is a parallelogram.
words.ex_cn: 这个形状有四条边，对边平行；它是一个平行四边形。
words.en: A parallelogram is a four-sided plane rectilinear figure with opposite sides parallel.

words.ex: The two lines are parallel lines and never meet.
words.ex_cn: 这两条线是平行线，从不相交。
words.en: Lines that are always the same distance apart and never meet.

words.tr:
adj. 垂直的；笔直的
n. 垂直线
words.ex: The lines are perpendicular to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这些线互相垂直。
words.en: At right angles to the plane of the horizon or a base line; vertical.

words.tr: phrase. 勾股定理；毕达哥拉斯定理
words.ex: The Pythagorean theorem is used to find the length of the hypotenuse of a right triangle.
words.ex_cn: 勾股定理用于求直角三角形斜边的长度。
words.en: The Pythagorean theorem is a fundamental principle in geometry that relates the lengths of the sides of a right triangle. It states that the square of the length of the hypotenuse (the side opposite the right angle) is equal to the sum of the squares of the lengths of the other two sides. This theorem is named after the ancient Greek mathematician Pythagoras.

words.tr: phrase. 饼形图；圆形分格统计图表
words.ex: The pie chart shows the percentage of students who like different fruits.
words.ex_cn: 饼状图显示了喜欢不同水果的学生的百分比。
words.en: A pie chart is a circular statistical graphic which is divided into slices to illustrate numerical proportion.

words.ex: The crystal has the shape of a quadrihedron.
words.ex_cn: 这块晶体的形状是一个四面体。
words.en: A quadrihedron is a polyhedron with four faces.

words.ex: The new policy has a wide radius of influence.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策的影响范围很广。
words.en: A straight line from the center to the circumference of a circle or sphere.

words.ex: The box has a rectangle shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是长方形的。
words.en: A rectangle is a four-sided flat shape where every interior angle is a right angle (90°). Opposite sides are parallel and of equal length.

words.tr: 正多边形：既等角又等边的多边形，也就是所有边长相等且所有内角相等的多边形。
words.ex: A square is a regular polygon with four equal sides.
words.ex_cn: 正方形是一个有四条相等边的正多边形。
words.en: A regular polygon is a polygon that is equiangular and equilateral, meaning that all sides are of equal length and all interior angles are of equal measure.

words.ex: The shape has four equal sides and is called a rhombus.
words.ex_cn: 这个形状有四条相等的边，叫做菱形。
words.en: A rhombus is a quadrilateral all of whose sides are of equal length.

words.ex: A right circular cylinder is often used in geometry problems.
words.ex_cn: 右圆柱体常用于几何问题中。
words.en: A right circular cylinder is a three-dimensional geometric figure that has two parallel circular bases connected by a curved surface, with the axis perpendicular to the bases.

words.ex: The right triangle has one 90-degree angle.
words.ex_cn: 这个直角三角形有一个90度的角。
words.en: A right triangle is a triangle in which one angle is a right angle (90 degrees).

words.tr: phrase. 直角：指一个角度为90°的角。
words.ex: The triangle has a right angle.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有一个直角。
words.en: An angle of 90°, as in a corner of a square or at the intersection of two perpendicular straight lines.

words.ex: A rectangular solid is a common geometric shape used in architecture.
words.ex_cn: 长方体是建筑中常用的几何形状。
words.en: A rectangular solid is a three-dimensional figure with six faces, all of which are rectangles.

words.tr: phrase. 正棱柱；正多边形底面的棱柱
words.ex: A regular prism has two congruent bases and all its faces are rectangles.
words.ex_cn: 规则棱镜有两个全等的底面，且所有面都是矩形。
words.en: A regular prism is a prism with bases that are regular polygons and sides that are rectangles.

words.tr: phrase. 正棱锥；底面为正多边形且顶点位于底面中心正上方的金字塔形立体
words.ex: A regular pyramid has congruent base angles and congruent lateral faces.
words.ex_cn: 一个正棱锥具有全等的底角和全等的侧面。
words.en: A regular pyramid is a pyramid with a regular polygon as its base and all lateral faces identical isosceles triangles.

words.tr: phrase. 正多面体；规则立体（各面均为全等的正多边形且各顶点情况相同的立体图形）
words.ex: A cube is a regular solid with six square faces.
words.ex_cn: 立方体是一个有六个正方形面的正多面体。
words.en: A regular solid is a polyhedron with congruent faces and angles, and all faces are regular polygons.

words.tr: phrase. 正多面体（所有面都是全等的正多边形且所有边和角都相等的立体图形）
words.ex: A cube is a regular polyhedron with six square faces.
words.ex_cn: 立方体是一个有六个正方形面的正多面体。
words.en: A regular polyhedron is a three-dimensional shape where all faces are congruent regular polygons and the same number of faces meet at each vertex.

words.ex: The children played on the slope behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的斜坡上玩耍。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.ex: The ball is a perfect sphere.
words.ex_cn: 这个球是一个完美的球体。
words.en: A sphere is a perfectly round three-dimensional shape, like a ball. It can also refer to a particular area of interest, activity, or knowledge.

words.tr: phrase. 圆的一个部分；圆弧与弦所围成的区域
words.ex: The area of the segment of a circle can be calculated using the radius and the central angle.
words.ex_cn: 圆的扇形面积可以通过半径和中心角计算。
words.en: A part of a circle bounded by a chord and the arc subtended by the chord.

words.ex: The child drew a semicircle on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在纸上画了一个半圆。
words.en: A semicircle is half of a circle, or something that has the shape of half a circle.

words.tr:
adj. 固体的；坚固的；可靠的；
n. 固体；
words.ex: Ice is a solid form of water.
words.ex_cn: 冰是水的固体形式。
words.en: A solid substance or object stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.ex: A straight angle is 180 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 平角是180度。
words.en: A straight angle is an angle that measures exactly 180 degrees, which is the angle formed by a straight line.

words.tr: phrase. 补角；两个角之和为180度时，彼此互为补角
words.ex: In geometry, the supplementary angles of a given angle are those whose sum is 180 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 在几何学中，给定角度的补角是那些和为180度的角度。
words.en: In geometry, a supplementary angle is one of a pair of angles with measures that add up to 180 degrees.

words.tr: phrase. 不等边圆柱（指横截面非圆形或侧面不规则的圆柱体）
words.ex: The object resembles a scalene cylinder in shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个物体的形状类似于斜柱体。
words.en: A three-dimensional shape with two parallel circular bases and a curved surface.

words.ex: He drew a scalene triangle on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个不等边三角形。
words.en: A scalene triangle is a triangle in which all three sides are of different lengths.

words.tr: n. 梯形；不等边四边形
words.ex: The shape is a trapezoid with two parallel sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个形状是一个有两条平行边的梯形。
words.en: A flat shape with four straight sides, where one pair of opposite sides is parallel.

words.ex: The volume of the box is 10 cubic meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的体积是10立方米。
words.en: A volume is a book, especially one that is part of a series of books. It can also refer to the amount of space that a substance or object occupies, or the level of sound produced by a television, radio, etc.

words.ex: The width of the table is one meter.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的宽度是一米。
words.en: The width of something is the distance it measures from one side to the other.

words.tr: phrase. 垂直角；对顶角（两条相交直线所形成的相对角）
words.ex: The two vertical angles are equal.
words.ex_cn: 这两个垂直角相等。
words.en: In geometry, a vertical angle is each of the pairs of opposite angles made by two intersecting lines.

chapters.name: GMAT数学专业术语 Word problem terms:

words.ex: They paid five dollars apiece for the tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他们每人五美元买了票。
words.en: If something is given or sold apiece, each person is given or sold one, or each thing is sold for a particular amount.

words.ex: The income per capita is high in this country.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的人均收入很高。
words.en: Per capita is used to describe the average amount of something per person in a particular place.

words.ex: The temperature decreased to 10 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 温度下降到了10度。
words.en: To reduce something to a lower level or amount.

words.ex: The temperature decreased by 5 degrees last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚温度降低了5度。
words.en: To reduce something by a certain amount or percentage.

words.tr:
n. 支撑物；支架；牙箍
v. 支撑；绷紧；紧靠；准备好
words.ex: The old bookshelf needs a brace to stay steady.
words.ex_cn: 旧书架需要一个支撑物来保持稳定。
words.en: To brace oneself means to prepare oneself for something difficult or unpleasant.

words.tr:
adj. 首要的；大红色的
n. 红衣主教；枢机主教；基数
words.ex: This is a cardinal rule in our school.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们学校的一项首要规则。
words.en: A cardinal rule or quality is the most important one.

words.ex: The apple costs 50 cents.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果售价50分。
words.en: A cent is a small unit of money in many countries. In the United States, a cent is equal to one hundredth of a dollar.

words.ex: The coin is made of nickel.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币是镍制的。
words.en: A hard silver-white metal that is used in making alloys and is a chemical element. It is also a coin worth five cents in the US and Canada.

words.ex: He found a dime on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上找到一枚一角硬币。
words.en: A dime is a coin worth ten cents, one tenth of a United States dollar.

words.ex: He found a penny on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上发现了一便士。
words.en: A penny is a small unit of currency used in the United Kingdom and the United States. In the UK, it is the smallest denomination of the pound sterling, and in the US, it is a cent, the smallest denomination of the dollar.

words.tr: phrase. 分期付款的首次付款；预付定金
words.ex: He made a down payment on a new car.
words.ex_cn: 他为一辆新车付了首付款。
words.en: A down payment is a sum of money that you pay when you are buying something expensive such as a car or a house and cannot pay the full amount immediately. You pay the down payment first and then pay the rest later.

words.tr: phrase. 简单利息：仅根据贷款的原始本金或账户金额计算或支付的利息。
words.ex: He earned simple interest on his savings.
words.ex_cn: 他从储蓄中获得了简单利息。
words.en: Interest calculated only on the principal amount of a loan or deposit, and not on previously earned interest.

words.ex: The bank pays compound interest every year.
words.ex_cn: 银行每年支付复利。
words.en: Compound interest is interest calculated on the initial principal and also on the accumulated interest of previous periods of a deposit or loan.

words.ex: He hurt his foot while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了脚。
words.en: The lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks.

words.ex: I bought a dozen eggs from the store.
words.ex_cn: 我从商店买了十二个鸡蛋。
words.en: If you have a dozen things, you have twelve of them.

words.ex: The gross income of the company is $5 million.
words.ex_cn: 公司的总收入是500万美元。
words.en: If you describe something as gross, you mean it is very obvious, unacceptable, or unpleasant.

words.ex: He bought a gallon of milk from the store.
words.ex_cn: 他从商店买了一加仑牛奶。
words.en: A gallon is a unit of measurement for liquids that is equal to eight pints. In Britain, it is equal to about 4.546 litres. In America, it is equal to about 3.785 litres.

words.ex: He bought a quart of milk at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店买了一夸脱牛奶。
words.en: A quart is a unit of measurement for liquids, equal to two pints or approximately 1.14 liters.

words.ex: The weather report said it's 90 degrees Fahrenheit today.
words.ex_cn: 天气预报说今天是90华氏度。
words.en: Of or relating to a temperature scale that registers the freezing point of water as 32° and the boiling point as 212° at one atmosphere of pressure.

words.ex: The depth of the river is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的深度很危险。
words.en: The distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；
v. 不全信；不重视；
words.ex: The store gave a 20% discount on all shoes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有鞋子提供了20%的折扣。
words.en: A reduction in the usual price of something, or the act of reducing the price.

words.ex: The teacher showed a cumulative graph of student scores.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一张学生成绩的累积图。
words.en: A chart or diagram that displays the cumulative total of data points over time or categories.

words.tr:
n. 兴趣；利息；利益；
v. 使产生兴趣；
words.ex: He has a strong interest in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画有浓厚的兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.tr: n. 差额；边缘；净利润；余地；
words.ex: The profit margin is five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 利润差额是五美元。
words.en: The margin is the edge or border of something, or the difference between two amounts, especially the difference between the cost of producing something and the price it is sold for.

words.tr:
n. 利润；
v. 获利；
words.ex: The company made a big profit this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年赚了大量利润。
words.en: Profit is the amount of money that you gain when you are paid more for something than it cost you to make, get, or do it.

words.ex: The retail price of this product is quite high.
words.ex_cn: 这个产品的零售价格相当高。
words.en: The price at which goods are sold to the public by retailers.

words.ex: He drank a pint of beer after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝了一品脱啤酒。
words.en: A pint is a unit of measurement for liquids. In Britain, it is equal to 568 cubic centimeters or one eighth of a gallon. In the United States, it is equal to 473 cubic centimeters or one eighth of a gallon.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.tr: phrase. 平年（指非闰年的普通年份，一年有365天）
words.ex: A common year has 365 days.
words.ex_cn: 一个普通年有365天。
words.en: A common year is a calendar year that is not a leap year, consisting of 365 days.

words.ex: The calendar must include an intercalary year to keep the seasons in sync with the months.
words.ex_cn: 日历必须包括一个闰年，以使季节与月份同步。
words.en: An intercalary year is a year that contains an extra day or month to keep the calendar year synchronized with the astronomical or seasonal year.

words.ex: February has 29 days in a leap year.
words.ex_cn: 闰年二月有29天。
words.en: A leap year is a year in which an extra day is added to the calendar in order to synchronize it with the astronomical year or seasonal year. In the Gregorian calendar, this is achieved by adding an extra day, February 29, to the month of February, making the year 366 days long instead of the usual 365.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.
